messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR Readout: consolidated customer health + renewal risk — action slate

Team — attaching the consolidated health matrix for our QBR readout tomorrow. I pulled together the top renewal risks and items that require exec attention before the meeting. High-level summary below; full matrix attached (qbr_health_matrix_20270322.xlsx).

Quick summary:
- Orion Labs (high risk): product latency regressions + commercial sensitivity on pricing; renewal due May 1.
- Polaris Analytics (medium risk): variable usage growth; potential overage dispute in April.
- ParcelSense (watch): stability incidents in Feb but backlog of CS wins.

Immediate asks (please confirm owners and ETA by 12:00 PT):
1) Technical deep dive for Orion (root cause & mitigation plan) — owner: Markus
2) Commercial proposal with an interim credits proposal + DocuSign envelope — owner: Ben
3) Canary rollout to reduce latency for ParcelSense (ops coordination) — owner: Marissa

Exec attention items to surface in QBR: 1) Consider an exception on advance credits for Orion pending final RCA; 2) Approve prioritized Eng hours (2 FTE-weeks) for Orion hotfix; 3) Approve temporary increased observability retention for Polaris (7 days -> 30 days) to resolve usage dispute.

Please reply inline with confirmations and any new risks you see. If you have additional evidence, drop into the Drive link. I will consolidate and share the brief at 3pm PT so we can rehearse ahead of the QBR.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Thanks, Rachel. I'll take the technical deep dive on Orion. Early read: latency regressions line up with a recent optimization we rolled into staging two weeks ago (attention kernel change). Priorities for the RCA:
- Reproduce the regression in a controlled environment (blocker if we can't reproduce)
- Trace KV cache invalidation timelines for impacted requests
- Check model variant routing rules that may have increased tail latency for long-context requests

I'll attach an impact brief with initial telemetry and an ask for 2 FTE-weeks from runtime engs. If Eng prioritization is required before QBR, flag it here — I recommend approval for 2-weeks to produce a mitigant patch.

Attachment: orion_impact_brief.pdf (pdf)

Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Runtime Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 13:05:22 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR Readout: consolidated customer health + renewal risk — action slate

Heads-up: ParcelSense (watch) also needs attention. We've seen two spikes tied to a customer-side change; ops has a small canary we can run that throttles high-cost paths for 48 hours. Plan: implement the latency_canary_plan.md and monitor. If stable, we can present this as a low-impact mitigation in the QBR.

I can own the rollout and will coordinate with infra; estimated time to start: tomorrow morning if Ops signs off.

Also, Polaris may need longer observability retention as Rachel called out — that will be a moderate cost lift but should clear the dispute quickly.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Reliability Lead, Redwood Inference

Appreciate the quick confirmations. Consolidating final asks and exec attention items for the QBR readout (I'll present):

ACTIONS (owners + ETA)
- Commercial proposal + DocuSign (Ben) — draft by EOD 3/22; envelope ready 3/23 11:00 PT. (attachment: DocuSign-Orion-Renewal.envelope)
- Technical RCA & mitigant patch (Markus) — staging reproduction + recommendation by 3/24 EOD; request approval for 2 FTE-weeks from Eng. (attachment: orion_impact_brief.pdf)
- Canary rollout for ParcelSense (Marissa) — start 3/23 AM; initial metrics by 3/24 10:00 PT. (attachment: latency_canary_plan.md)
- Observability retention change for Polaris (Rachel/Platform) — request approval in QBR to move 7->30 days for 30 days.

EXEC ATTENTION ITEMS (to surface in slides)
1) Approve temporary credits for Orion to maintain relationship while RCA completes (proposed: 1 month committed tokens).
2) Approve 2 FTE-weeks from Runtime Eng for mitigation work (cost = prioritization trade-off).
3) Approve short-term observability retention increase for Polaris to expedite dispute resolution.

EXTERNALS NOTIFICATION
- Derek Santos (Orion) is copied here to keep transparency ahead of the QBR. Derek: if you have any further telemetry or contract constraints to share, please reply-all.

I'll prepare a two-slide exec summary and circulate at 2:50pm PT for a 3:00pm PT rehearsal. Thanks all.

Rachel
